CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.restore_payment(payment_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE payments
  SET deleted_at = NULL
  WHERE id = payment_id AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL;
  
  RETURN FOUND;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.restore_payment(payment_id bigint)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE payments
  SET deleted_at = NULL
  WHERE id = payment_id AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL;
  
  RETURN FOUND;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.soft_delete_payment(payment_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE payments
  SET deleted_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = payment_id AND deleted_at IS NULL;
  
  RETURN FOUND;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.soft_delete_payment(payment_id bigint)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE payments
  SET deleted_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = payment_id AND deleted_at IS NULL;
  
  RETURN FOUND;
END;
$function$
